policy: For standard-size dresses, request return approval within 14 calendar days of receipt. Trying on is permitted. Keep the dress unworn except trying on, unwashed, unaltered and in its original condition with security seal intact. Customized items are excluded from ordinary returns; quality disputes require individual review. For an eligible ordinary return, refund the returned product price after receipt and inspection; original shipping is non-refundable and customer pays return postage. No restocking fee. No keep-item compensation or donation alternative is authorized by this fixture. After accepting an offer, obtain verified return instructions before shipping. Do not invent a street address, refund execution or timing.
